# OpenCode 1.19.5 session modes

new-session.json is the `session/new` answer of `opencode acp` 1.19.5 observed
on Windows x64 on 2026-11-02 under an isolated home (koru-ai D7), reduced to
its `model` and `mode` config options. Model ids and names are replaced. The
`mode` option's values are OpenCode's agent personas, `build` (current) and
`plan`; 1.19.5 sends no `modes` object.
